boho.method: per row, the low frequencies (sigma 2) across x 379-419 replaced by a straight ramp from the wall at the band's left end (beside the bamboo light's ball, where no clean wall is left, the fill's own level) to the fill at its right end; fine grain kept, at the seam itself (x 395-403) the fill's grain from 8 px right; the light's pixels kept out

a_rim_echo.method: per column, the band 4-20 px above the new bowl's tanned rim (the bowl and its lip highlight kept) rebuilt as a straight fit in y of the clean bench front above it (from y 1146; fits smoothed over 4 columns), with those rows' own grain

b_bench_cushions.cushions: left (x 208-604, y 713-1012) and middle (x 906-1223, y 724-966), outlines along their frayed tops; the right one stays white (ours)
b_bench_cushions.target: sand linen ~ L 61 a 6 b 19 against the white cushion's L 71 a 4 b 12
b_bench_cushions.method: hand outlines along the frayed flange (feathered 2 px), terracotta / hat / moss / gaps cut out by colour; Lab shift only, so the crinkle texture and the shading stay

a_cups.glaze: plain off-white (Lab a 0.8, b 5.5), the bowl stays ivory with its speckle
a_cups.method: cup outlines by lightness and low chroma per box; dots and the tanned rim lifted to a 7 px closing of L; a/b set to the glaze, L shading kept

b_fly.method: the dark glyph (L 6 below the cushion ground, grown 2 px) inpainted from the ground round it (Telea r 4) with its grain

c_curtains.method: curtain pixels by colour in each curtain's box (largest part, holes filled); Lab shift of the mean 60 % toward the card, the folds' own L variation kept
